assets.alt: 缓慢长队里，一位孩子放松地安静等候，旁边的孩子焦躁地催促；对比有耐心与不耐烦
assets.scene: A small slow-moving queue at a single ice-cream cart. Focus on TWO waiting children side by side behind the person being served. The central child is visibly calm and patient: loose relaxed shoulders, hands gently folded, soft peaceful smile, standing still and willingly giving the busy vendor time. Next to them a smaller secondary child is clearly impatient: foot tapping with tiny motion strokes, arms crossed, irritated frown, leaning forward and repeatedly looking at a plain watch. Vendor in the background is slowly scooping a hard scoop for someone else, explaining the delay. A clear tightly related contrast of CALM WAITING versus frustrated waiting; the relaxed patient child's demeanor must dominate. No medical context, no shoelace tying, no reading, no distracting scenery.
